subject: Renewal discussion / bake-off — capacity uplift & save plan
messages:
From: Amy Liu <amy.liu@sparkleai.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal conversation: Q2 capacity and benchmarking

Hi Jonas —

Quick note from SparkleAI as we look toward our renewal in late March. We have an internal mandate to validate unit economics and tail latency for our inference workloads. Over the past week we kicked off a short bake-off that includes one of your competitors (LatticeInference).

Reality: current spend is fine but the execs want to see either better price or a demonstrable operational advantage to stick with Redwood. Two asks:
- Can we get an up-to-date performance benchmark (p99 latency and throughput) on our current model profile?
- Are you able to offer a short-term capacity uplift (30% extra ded. capacity for 30 days) while we run the test?

Timeline: procurement needs numbers by 2/20 to decide whether to continue the Redwood renewal or move to a replacement.

Amy
Amy Liu
Head of Product Operations, SparkleAI
amy.liu@sparkleai.com

---
Attachments: none referenced in this initial note
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation: Q2 capacity and benchmarking

Amy — thanks for the heads up and the clarity on timeline. We absolutely want to keep SparkleAI on Redwood and can move quickly to prove value. Proposed immediate steps: 

1) Technical benchmark run with your prompt set (you can drop a representative file or a small corpus). Priyom will own execution and produce p50/p95/p99 and throughput curves.
2) 30-day trial for a temporary capacity uplift — we can grant a 30% dedicated capacity uplift free for 30 days while the bake-off runs.
3) Commercial: draft a save offer if metrics match SLOs (we'll follow up with a tailored price adjustment for renewal).

I attached a short renewal summary so your procurement folks have current utilization and spend broken down by model/route. Let's lock a 30-min sync tomorrow to scope the benchmark.

Jonas Weber
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147

Hi Amy —

Thanks for looping us in. Quick plan for the benchmark (high level):
- Inputs: 1) representative prompt set (we ask for ~500 prompts that reflect your production mix), 2) token length distribution.
- Targets: p99 latency <120ms at 1k RPS for the current model size (512 token avg). We'll measure tail latency, throughput, and memory/KV cache hit rates.
- Environment: we'll provision a temporary dedicated pool that matches the hardware in your production plan; we can also run a variant with our quantized serving profile to show cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Duration: 48-72 hour continuous run plus an aggregate report.

I attached a short benchmark plan with exact commands and artifacts we'll produce. If you can provide the prompt set and a test dataset by EOD Monday (2/16) we can start on Tuesday and report before your 2/20 procurement deadline.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Jonas / Priyom —

Appreciate the quick response and the plan. A couple of updates from our side after running the first half of the bake-off:
- LatticeInference currently shows ~10% lower p99 on our standard prompt set in identical hardware; cost is a bit lower too.
- Procurement is specifically asking whether Redwood can match price AND show that there is operational upside (fewer infra surprises during spikes).
- Compliance: procurement wants confirmation on SOC 2 scope and a copy of the audit evidence for the last 12 months.

We will upload the 500-prompt set and sample token distribution to the secure share by EOD Monday. That will be the canonical set for the bake-off. For the price discussion — what flexibility does Redwood have on renewal term/credits for a 12-month commit? Also, can you confirm the 30-day uplift is guaranteed and provisioned by 2/18 if we accept?

Michael Chen
Procurement, SparkleAI

Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:00:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation: Q2 capacity and benchmarking — proposed save plan

Amy / Michael —

Thanks for the transparent notes and for sharing the prompt set. I own commercial escalation for strategic renewals — wanted to propose a concrete save plan so SparkleAI has something to take into procurement immediately: 

1) Commercial: If SparkleAI commits to a 12-month renewal by 2/25 we will extend a 15% renewal credit applied to net-new committed spend for the 12-month term. Credits apply to the renewal invoice schedule.
2) Capacity: We will provision the 30% dedicated capacity uplift for 30 days at zero charge starting within 48 hours of a signed MSA addendum; priority provisioning guaranteed.
3) Performance guarantees: If the benchmark run (using the uploaded prompt set) meets our agreed p99 targets, we will include a one-time SLO credit (service credit up to 5% of monthly committed spend) for any month in the first quarter where p99 exceeds the target.
4) Compliance: Grace will share our SOC 2 Type II evidence package and a pointer to our audit kit for your security team within 24 hours.

We’re confident the trial and the quantized serving run will demonstrate cost/latency tradeoffs that favor Redwood for your production pattern. If you want, I can also offer a short executive briefing with our product lead to walk the results to your CTO.

If that sounds reasonable I’ll send a short addendum (SOW) and the provisioning request so we can start the uplift.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
